_doc: Fernflug Act I, Werk Thalbach: the living world (UPDATE 10 §3, contract C1, DECISIONS T-155). MapRoot attaches a MapAmbience with this file (MapRoot._attach_map_ambience); the map has no Landscape, so needs_landscape is false and every kind lives under "act1" (the U10 Act I block at the end of gravelight/world/landscape/map_ambience.gd; the visual pieces are ThalbachLife). Presentation only, per peer. Positions are map space (+X east, +Z north). windows_out: from act round from_round, per_round lit windows get their blackout blinds drawn at random times within spread_s (the Siedlung's first; markers Gameplay/LitWindows). bell: the church bell on the wind every interval s. low_pass: a test jet from `from` to `to` in `seconds` at act round `round` (+delay). searchlights: ThalbachSky.apply_cfg (forest = extra beam bases on the ridges). train: a locomotive and `cars` flatcars run in on the siding behind the goods shed at act round `round` and every every_rounds after, stopping at `stop` (emits a1_train_arrived: the railwayman's favour). kranich_glow: the intakes' violet breath up through the hangar skylight (seen from spawn above the works wall). rattle / sway / weld: the reactive details (points; sway rows are [x, y, z, drop, yaw]). posters: the two fictional marks only (docs/ART_FACTIONS.md §1 and §1b). power_on: the PA horns, the jig gantries' jolt, a sting per perk machine as its zone lights.

horror._doc: UPDATE 11 section 6 (T-192): grit and dread on this map (HorrorLayer, gravelight/world/horror_layer.gd; presentation only, every block off when absent). The chant bed is our own synthesis (gen_audio_horror.py), not a recording; the levels keep docs/AUDIO_MIX.md's rule (the bed at its loudest sits 8 dB under a footstep with the map bed under it).

_doc_t271: T-271: three of Map 0's sky-war kinds, copied as they are in map00_ambience.json (the bomber streams droning over high up, the low fighter pairs with tracer, a far machine gun), with Map 0's intensity curve. They are the ones that need no Landscape node and nothing of Map 0's geometry (SkyFlight builds its own planes; the gun is a sound from a bearing). Left out because they draw on the Landscape's sky (Thalbach has none): artillery and its flashes on the cloud deck, flak tracers, flares, searchlight beams (Thalbach has its own under act1), the burning town's glow, plane_down (it crashes behind Map 0's hills); and everything that is the inn's (crows on its wires, the dog, the sign, the shutter, the bell, the farm light, the chimney, the wreck's cook-off, the pilot's line, frost on its windows).
